title: Canonical compact-support exchange, scalar and refinement data
statement:
Fix a universe $u$, schemes in universe $u$, and commutative coefficient rings in universe $u+1$. Use compactifications and refinements of [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] and the constant-ring module operations underlying [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. On the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant-ring module sheaves on the small pro-etale site, define $G_f$ as exact localization of module inverse image, $R_f$ as total right-derived module direct image, and $J_j$ as exact localization of module extension by zero. Retain their induced ordinary-adjunction normalizations. Define the source square $G_iG_r\cong G_pG_k$ of a commuting scheme square $pk=ir$ by the canonical constant-section-normalized derived pullback compositors and equality transport. For compactifications $c=(j,p)$ and $c'=(j',p')$ with proper and open Cartesian squares, define $H_a:F_cG_a\to G_xF_{c'}$, where $F_c=J_jR_p$ in Lean functor-composition order, as the proper adjunction mate followed by the inverse open-extension comparison of [def-exchange-projection], with the canonical associators inserted. These are ordinaryG, ordinaryR, ordinaryJ, sourceSquare and ordinaryH.

For a refinement $v:c\to d$ and a quasi-compact original morphism, define ordinaryC to be the natural transformation $F_d\to F_c$ obtained by inserting the inverse direct-image identity, applying the intrinsic clopen proper/open comparison for $(j_c,1_X,v,j_d)$, pushing forward along $p_d$, and applying the direct-image compositor and $vp_d=p_c$ transport. It is defined on all ordinary complexes; no Cartesian refinement square is required.

For arbitrary rings $C_n$ and transitions $C_{n+1}\to C_n$, use the simultaneous-system operations and adjunctions of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations] and the canonical squareP comparison of [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons]. Define SemilinearProperOpen.exchange for any commuting square as the adjunction mate of squareP.hom under $P_p\dashv R_p$ and $P_r\dashv R_r$, using [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate].

For a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $i:E\to F$, and a Noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, use the raw rational categories of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] and the canonical completed coefficient maps constructed by the valuation-ring, quotient and completion procedure of [def-weil-pbc-finite-completed-coefficient-map]. Define pbcRationalScalarExtension along $i$ by the constructible restriction of completed derived scalar extension followed by raw scalar localization; its object map is the integral derived tensor image and its morphism map is the induced localized tensor-Hom map. There is no Karoubi envelope.

Finally, for an adic coefficient datum $d$, the completed compact-support operations of [def-sf-completed-compact-support-calculus-data], a quasi-compact $f$ and a refinement $v:c\to d'$, define cbcRefinementMap at $K$ by the same identity--clopen-gamma--proper-compositor construction on completed modules, directed from $F_{d'}K$ to $F_cK$. All maps are the published constructions, not arbitrary arrows or data chosen from a pasting theorem. This definition asserts no invertibility, normalization law, or pasting equation.
